title: Eight Winters and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：fear　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fear 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1944 my grandmother ① felt a fear that no neighbour in the lane would have named, and she said the feeling was the whole of the winter. The ② fear, meaning the dread itself and not the danger, ran eight winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a fear, she said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ fear in that lane had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ fear at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the night and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fear, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandmother said the naming is the part that fills eight winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fear was the whole of the letter, meaning the worry and not the dread. The ⑥ fear, meaning the worry and not any of that, is the only thing in a letter that everybody waits for and nobody names; fear, he said, is either something you feel or the only word that means both dread and worry. He said the worry is the part they remember.

By 1952 the ⑦ fear had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ fear of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one lane and eight winters of naming; fear, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fear I remember is the one named in the diary, which closed in 1954 and is still described as the quietest in the lane. A ⑩ fear, my mother said in 1956, is the only one that improves by being named; every fear, she said, is worry that has agreed to look like dread. She said the worry was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 恐惧；害怕（指巷子里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 恐惧（指那一份本身，与危险相对）
C. 固定搭配：feel a fear 感到一份恐惧
D. n. 恐惧（指留给夜晚的那一份）
E. n. 恐惧（抽象总称，指一条巷子的惧怕之事）
F. n. 恐惧（指日记上写到、被说出的那一份）
G. n. 担忧；忧虑（指一封信里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）
H. n. 忧虑（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西）

items.q: felt a fear that no neighbour in the lane would have named
The fear, meaning the dread itself and not the danger
the fear at the far side
the fear was the whole of the letter
the fear had become a line in a diary
The fear of the whole thing
A fear, my mother said in 1956

answers.why: feel a fear 意为“感到一份恐惧”，1944 年祖母感到了一份巷子里没有一位邻居肯说出的恐惧。
fear 意为“恐惧”，指那一份本身而不是危险，它经过了八个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
fear 意为“恐惧”，指巷子里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一盏短短的灯。
fear 意为“恐惧”，指留给夜晚的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fear 意为“担忧、忧虑”，指一封信里人人都等却无人说出的那样东西，叔叔说这份忧虑就是那封信的全部。
fear 意为“忧虑”，指人人都等却无人说出的那样东西而不是那一份恐惧，是信里人人都等、却无人说出的东西。
fear 意为“恐惧”，指日记上写到、被说出的那一份，到 1952 年这一份成了日记里的一行。
fear 意为“恐惧”，祖母一月写道，整件事的惧怕之事是一条巷子和八个冬天的说出。
fear 意为“恐惧”，我记得的是日记上说出的那一份，1954 年结束了，至今仍被说成巷子里最安静的一份。
fear 为抽象总称，母亲 1956 年说，一份恐惧是唯一会因为被好好说出而变得更好的东西。
